entities.name: Michael Hjälm
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michael Peter Hjälm is an ice hockey player who played for the Swedish national team. He won a bronze medal at the 1984 and 1988 Winter Olympics. Drafted by the Philadelphia Flyers in the 1982 NHL Entry Draft, Hjälm spent his entire 15 season playing career in Sweden.
